noShowReduction.intro: An automated multi-channel reminder system that drove a 3-chair dental clinic's no-show rate from 28% to 9% in 90 days.
noShowReduction.problem: A mid-sized dental clinic was losing thousands in revenue every month to a 28% no-show rate. Manual reminder calls were inconsistent, and the front-desk team couldn't keep up — industry data shows no-show rates above 20% cost small practices $150K+ annually in lost chair time.
noShowReduction.solution: Axiogen deployed an automated reminder system that delivers personalized SMS, WhatsApp, and email reminders at clinically-optimal intervals (72h, 24h, and 2h before the visit). Patients can confirm, reschedule, or cancel with a single tap — and cancellations instantly trigger waitlist outreach to fill the slot. The system includes:

solutionBullets.1: Three-touch reminder sequence timed to evidence-based intervals
solutionBullets.2: One-tap confirm, reschedule, or cancel from any channel
solutionBullets.3: Instant waitlist outreach when slots open up
solutionBullets.4: Real-time calendar sync with practice management software
solutionBullets.5: Language and tone tuned to each clinic's patient base

results.2: Over 40 appointment slots recovered per month

voiceReceptionist.intro: A 24/7 AI voice receptionist that answered every missed call at a dental practice and booked 47 new patients after-hours in the first 90 days.
voiceReceptionist.problem: A dental practice was losing an estimated 30+ calls per week outside business hours and during peak times when the front desk was overwhelmed. Each missed call was a potential new patient — industry research shows 67% of callers who reach voicemail never call back.
voiceReceptionist.solution: Axiogen built an AI voice receptionist (Nova) on Vapi, GPT-4o, and ElevenLabs that answers every call, collects patient details, books appointments directly into the practice management calendar, and sends confirmations — all in natural, human-sounding conversation. The solution includes:

solutionBullets.1: Natural-sounding voice conversation with sub-second latency
solutionBullets.2: Direct booking into the practice's calendar system
solutionBullets.4: Live handoff to human staff for complex or urgent cases

results.1: 47 new patients booked after-hours in 90 days
results.2: 100% call answer rate, day or night

patientReactivation.intro: A 6-week automated re-engagement sequence that reactivated 127 lapsed patients at a dermatology clinic — all without adding staff hours.
patientReactivation.problem: The clinic had thousands of dormant patient records — people who had come once for a consultation or treatment and never returned. Manual outreach was impractical at that scale, and the clinic was leaving years of recall revenue on the table.
patientReactivation.solution: Axiogen segmented 2,300 dormant patients by original visit type and built an automated WhatsApp + SMS reactivation sequence with personalized offers tailored to each segment (cosmetic follow-ups, skin-cancer screenings, prescription refills, etc.). Responses flowed directly into the online booking system. Features include:

solutionBullets.1: Segmentation by original treatment type and time-since-visit
solutionBullets.2: Personalized messaging and offer per segment
solutionBullets.3: Multi-touch cadence across WhatsApp, SMS, and email
solutionBullets.5: Real-time performance dashboard for the practice manager

results.2: 5.5% reactivation rate on a dormant list
results.3: $45K+ in recovered revenue with zero additional staff overhead

reviewAutomation.intro: An automated post-visit review system that lifted a cosmetic practice's Google rating from 3.8 to 4.7 stars in four months.
reviewAutomation.problem: A cosmetic practice had excellent clinical outcomes but a 3.8-star Google rating — because only unhappy patients were motivated enough to leave reviews. Staff regularly forgot to ask, paper cards ended up in the trash, and the practice's reputation was silently hurting new-patient acquisition.
reviewAutomation.solution: Axiogen built an automated reputation system that sends a personalized review request via SMS two hours after each visit — while the experience is still fresh. Happy patients receive a direct link to Google, while patients who rate below 4 stars are routed to a private feedback form delivered straight to the practice manager. The solution includes:

solutionBullets.1: Timed post-visit review request via SMS
solutionBullets.2: Smart routing: 4–5 stars go public, ≤3 stars stay private
solutionBullets.3: Personalized messaging using patient and clinician names
solutionBullets.4: Private-feedback inbox for the practice manager
solutionBullets.5: Review performance dashboard with month-over-month tracking

results.1: Google rating climbed from 3.8 to 4.7 stars in 4 months
results.3: Negative feedback captured privately, not publicly

digitalIntake.intro: A mobile-first digital intake flow that saved a dermatology clinic 7+ hours of front-desk time every week and cut waiting-room times in half.
digitalIntake.problem: Front-desk staff were spending 20+ minutes per new patient on intake paperwork and manual data entry — creating waiting-room backlogs, data-entry errors, and burnout. Paper forms also slowed insurance verification and delayed clinician prep time.
digitalIntake.solution: Axiogen built a mobile-first digital intake flow that sends patients a secure link 24 hours before their appointment. Patients complete medical history, consent forms, insurance information, and e-signatures on their phone — and everything syncs directly into the EHR before they arrive. Key features include:

solutionBullets.1: Pre-visit link delivered via SMS and email 24h before appointment
solutionBullets.2: Mobile-first forms with conditional logic and auto-save
solutionBullets.3: E-signature for consent and HIPAA documents
solutionBullets.4: Insurance photo capture with automated verification
solutionBullets.5: Direct EHR sync so clinicians are prepped before the patient walks in

results.1: 7+ hours of front-desk time saved per week
results.3: Waiting-room times reduced by an average of 18 minutes

about.subtitle: Modernizing healthcare operations with intelligent SaaS platforms and AI-driven automation
about.missionStatement: At Axiogen, we partner with healthcare organizations to build intelligent software infrastructure that transforms clinical operations. Our mission is to modernize medical institutions with custom SaaS platforms and AI-powered automation that enhance patient care, streamline workflows, and drive operational excellence.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: Axiogen is a healthcare-focused SaaS and automation company specializing in custom software development for medical institutions. We design and build enterprise-grade digital platforms that address the complex operational challenges faced by hospitals, clinics, universities, and healthcare organizations. Our team brings together software engineers, healthcare workflow specialists, and AI experts who understand the nuances of medical operations and regulatory compliance.

whyWeExist.title: Why We Exist
whyWeExist.description: Healthcare organizations face unprecedented operational complexity—fragmented systems, administrative overload, and inefficient workflows that drain resources and impact patient care. We founded Axiogen to solve these systemic challenges through purpose-built software platforms and intelligent automation. Our goal is to empower medical institutions with modern technology infrastructure that reduces administrative burden, improves operational efficiency, and enables healthcare professionals to focus on delivering exceptional patient outcomes.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: In healthcare, accuracy is non-negotiable. Every platform we build is engineered with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring data integrity, regulatory compliance, and reliable performance across all clinical workflows and patient interactions.

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.description: We design software that eliminates operational friction. Every platform and automation we build is optimized to streamline workflows, reduce administrative overhead, and maximize resource utilization—enabling healthcare organizations to scale effectively while maintaining quality of care.

care.title: Care & Empathy
care.description: We deeply understand the human side of healthcare. Our solutions are designed with empathy for both patients and providers—creating technology that enhances the care experience, reduces burnout, and supports better health outcomes for everyone in the healthcare ecosystem.
